mapper.select: SELECT cs.*, u.NAME as USER_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME as DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, c.CALENDAR_NAME as CALENDAR_NAME FROM TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON cs.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON cs.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON cs.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE cs.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY cs.SHARED_AT DESC

SELECT cs.*, u.NAME as USER_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME as DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.NAME as SHARED_BY_NAME, c.CALENDAR_NAME as CALENDAR_NAME FROM TB_CALENDAR_SHARE cs INNER JOIN TB_CALENDAR c ON cs.CALENDAR_ID = c.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON cs.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_USER su ON cs.SHARED_BY = su.USERNAME WHERE cs.CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId} AND cs.USERNAME = #{username} AND cs.DELETED_AT IS NULL
